headline: Battle Ledger Shows Deadlands and Farranac Activity
war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast has become the clearest fresh movement front, recording three strategic-base events in the latest two hours and six across the day; its ledger now shows nine Colonial-held bases against two Warden-held. Deadlands has also resumed visible movement, with two events in six hours and 16 in 24, while its 11 bases stand divided four to seven between the Wardens and Colonials. Fisherman’s Row remains a heavily contested sector by the day’s totals, with 21 events recorded, though none in the latest two hours and its present split is eight Warden bases to one Colonial. The former activity at Tempest Island, Stema Landing, and Lykos Isle has gone quiet in the latest window; their daily event counts stand at three, six, and five respectively. The heaviest casualty ledgers remain Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Kings Cage, Linn’s Mercy, and Loch Mor, with current rates especially substantial in Weathered and Stlican. Most other sectors show no recorded base movement and only light enlistment or casualty activity.
